Production deployment dpl_ThiEtb3B929CTxYLqbJSN5LKTVNc.
photoAndRetentionMaintenance.behavior: Revocation and account deletion deny subsequent photo access immediately. Maintenance sweeps expired pending uploads, deletes at most 100 queued objects through the Storage API, and acknowledges paths only after success. Repeated calls drain backlog and clean diagnostic/push retention records.
photoAndRetentionMaintenance.verification: Check 200 responses and generic count logs. A 401 means scheduler authorization is missing; 503 requires configuration or dependency checks. A growing queue or failed schedule means physical blob deletion is outstanding even though access has been revoked.
photoAndRetentionMaintenance.followUp: Add periodic reconciliation of private bucket objects without photo_assets metadata to cover rare in-flight upload/removal races. Do not delete storage.objects directly in SQL.

backups.database: Verify the dedicated project's database backup coverage, retention and restore procedure. Test restores into an isolated environment.
backups.privateStorage: Database backup and private image-object backup are separate recovery tasks. Maintain a restricted, encrypted object backup and a matching metadata snapshot if photo recovery is required; verify both in a restore drill.
backups.restore: Reconcile deletion/revocation records before restoring visibility. Do not accidentally restore deleted photos or previously revoked grants to members.

pushNotifications.enablement: Keep both flags off until Apple credentials, correct APNs topic/environment, signed provisioning and physical-iPhone acceptance tests are complete. Test permission refusal, background delivery, tap routing, blocking, pause, expired subscription, logout and account switching.
pushNotifications.details: See docs/push-setup.json. APNs secrets and service credentials belong only in server production scope; do not copy them into preview builds.

monitoring.implementation: Generic authenticated client fault counters and owner-only MFA-protected health totals. No Sentry integration is configured.
monitoring.retention: 30 calendar days in Asia/Riyadh; maintenance also removes old notification jobs.
monitoring.privacy: Counts contain event category, platform, numeric release and day. Do not add exception messages, stack traces, profile answers, chat bodies, photo paths or tokens to telemetry.
monitoring.operations: Review health counts and worker success/failure logs after releases. External alert delivery and uptime paging require separate configuration.

previewsAndStaging.syntheticPreview: Use VITE_MARRIAGE_ENV=demo for the member app and VITE_ADMIN_MODE=demo for admin previews. Synthetic previews exercise UI with fictional data; a Vercel preview alone is not an isolated staging database.
previewsAndStaging.isolatedStaging: Provision a separate Supabase project, apply reviewed migrations and seed only synthetic accounts. Never use either the live Nisfayn project or BlindMatch event project as staging.

adminClient.VITE_SUPABASE_URL: The same separate staging project URL

previewsAndStaging.workers: Current workers intentionally allow only the dedicated live Nisfayn project and VERCEL_ENV=production. Staging worker testing needs a separately reviewed isolated configuration; never weaken the production guard for preview.

ciAndRelease.activation: Commit and push the workflow/source to the intended repository. A local test pass is not evidence of a hosted Actions run.
ciAndRelease.checks: Node 22: member tests and demo build; admin worker tests and demo build; isolated PGlite migration/authorization tests. Triggers on relevant pull requests, pushes and manual dispatch.
ciAndRelease.limits: CI does not deploy migrations or certify hosted Supabase Storage, APNs delivery or a signed iPhone build. Verify the intended Vercel deployment and complete native acceptance tests separately.
releaseSteps: Require passing checks; confirm backup coverage and exact target project IDs.
Apply additive reviewed migrations to the dedicated project, then deploy the compatible frontend.
Verify admin login/TOTP, role boundaries, member flows and worker authorization before enabling delivery or schedules.
ciAndRelease.rollback: Promote the previous known-good frontend deployment if needed. Disable push delivery or a failing schedule while investigating. Correct database issues with a reviewed forward migration; do not reset the database, drop member tables, delete member data or alter BlindMatch as a rollback.
